02 · Clock calls in combat

  • 02_01There's four of them, one o'clock high. They're coming around. Watch.
  • 02_02Two fighters, six o'clock up, coming in, diving at you.
  • 02_03B-17 in trouble, out at two o'clock, watch it. Got an engine on fire.
  • 02_04Two more diving through the 94th.
  • 02_05Three planes, nine o'clock, coming around. Keep your eye on them, boys.
  • 02_06Coming around to ten. Watch him, Chuck. Keep your eyes open. They're breaking eleven. Breaking eleven. I got him.
  • 02_07Coming around here at 8 or 10 o'clock. I see him.
  • 02_08Watch him, Scotty. I got my sights on him.
  • 02_09Check that B-17, Chuck. Three o'clock. Motor's smoking. Fighters, ten-thirty. Coming around.
  • 02_10Ten-thirty, upper or lower?

  • 03_02He come out of the bomb bay. Yeah, I see him.
  • 03_03There's a tail gunner coming out. Watch out for the fighter.
  • 03_04Keep your eye on him, Bill. See any parachutes, Quinlan? No parachutes.
  • 03_05Flak at nine o'clock.
  • 03_06Eight men still in that B-17.
